title: Concentrate · verb
subtitle: 「專注／留心／全神貫注／鎖定重點」，究竟是哪一種 concentrate？
description: 「專注／留心／全神貫注／鎖定重點」，究竟是哪一種 concentrate？

words.note: 使用者提供，也是 concentrate 最核心、最自然的近義詞之一。focus 表示把注意力、思考或努力集中在某件事上，日常、學術和工作語境都很常見。
words.example: Try to focus on the main argument.

exercises.original: You need to concentrate on the road while driving.
exercises.zh: 駕駛時你需要專注於路面。
exercises.upgrade: focus · 專注；集中注意力

options.explanation: on the road + driving safety requires sustained attention to one main target.
常與 instructions, pedestrians, what someone says 等需留意的信息／環境搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 sustained attention to one main task；這裡需要的是「一般集中注意力」。因此 pay attention 雖與 concentrate 有關，但注意力的程度、是否涉及處理任務、是否存在干擾或是否需要縮窄目標並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 集中鎖定；把注意力精準放在
words.note: 較口語、帶比喻意味。zero in on 表示從很多可能性中把注意力精準集中到一個特定問題、原因、細節或目標。它比一般 concentrate 更有 narrowing-down 的意味。
words.example: The investigators zeroed in on a fault in the control system.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者高度接近；focus on 是最直接的一般替代。concentrate 也常強調持續用力保持注意力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Try to focus on the task. I cannot concentrate in this noise.

falseSynonyms.zh: pay attention 強調留心某資訊／環境；concentrate 更強調持續集中精神。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Pay attention to the instructions. Concentrate on solving the problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: attend to 通常表示處理、照料某事項，不只是心理專注。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She attended to the complaints. She concentrated on the report.

falseSynonyms.zh: stare 只是長時間看；眼睛盯著某物不等於精神上專注。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He stared at the screen. He concentrated on the calculation.

falseSynonyms.zh: think 範圍很廣，可以只是思考；concentrate 明確要求把注意力集中。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I need to think about the problem. I need to concentrate on this calculation.

falseSynonyms.zh: relax 是放鬆，不是集中注意力；雖然放鬆有時能幫助專注，兩者仍不是同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Try to relax before the exam. Concentrate on one question at a time.

falseSynonyms.zh: concentrate 是動詞；concentration 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I need to concentrate. This task requires concentration.

falseSynonyms.zh: concentrated 可是形容詞／過去分詞，也可表示物質濃縮；本課的 target 是動詞『專注』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She concentrated on the task. The solution is highly concentrated.
